subject: question/suggestion for guide defaults when mapping fill and shape

messages.author: d4005c0b4ec1132e
messages.subject: question/suggestion for guide defaults when mapping fill and shape
parts:
When I map shape and fill to different factors, the legend uses a default shape that has no fill (shape = 1, I think).

mydf<-data.frame(Type=rep(c("Type A","Type B"), each =50),

                 Style=c("Style 1", "Style 2"),

                 Var1=runif(100),

                 Var2=runif(100))

 

p<-ggplot(data=mydf, aes(x=Var1, y=Var2, shape=Type,fill=Style))+

  geom_point()+

  scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,24))

 

p #Note the uninterpretable “Style” legend

 

I just learned you can override this with a different shape with the following:

p+ guide(fill=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21))

 

 

I have a question and suggestion:

-Is there a way to make the legend show all relevant combinations of shapes/fills (i.e., combine shape and type into a single legend)? You can do this by creating a new variable, but that seems like a clumsy workaround….

-When mapping a variable to fill, the default shape for the legend should be one that actually has a fill (such as shapes 21 through 25).

 

Thanks!
